b1-arpadhaz-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The House of Árpád
b1-arpadhaz-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the Árpád dynasty.
b1-arpadhaz-01.prompt: Tell the official who the Árpád dynasty descended from and how long it provided Hungary's kings.
cues: Say who the dynasty descended from
Say how long it provided kings
b1-arpadhaz-01.target: Az Árpád-ház Árpád fejedelem leszármazottaiból állt, és háromszáz évig adta Magyarország királyait.
b1-arpadhaz-01.english: The Árpád dynasty consisted of the descendants of Prince Árpád, and it provided Hungary's kings for three hundred years.
b1-arpadhaz-01.canDo: I can name the Árpád dynasty as Hungary's founding royal house, descended from Árpád.

b1-arpadhaz-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Golden Bull
b1-arpadhaz-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what the Golden Bull was.
b1-arpadhaz-02.prompt: Tell the official who issued the Golden Bull in 1222 and what it did to the king's power.
cues: Say who issued it and when
b1-arpadhaz-02.target: II. András, aki 1222-ben kiadta az Aranybullát, a nemesek nyomására korlátozta a király hatalmát.
b1-arpadhaz-02.english: Andrew II, who issued the Golden Bull in 1222, limited the king's power under pressure from the nobles.
b1-arpadhaz-02.canDo: I can explain what the Aranybulla (Golden Bull) of 1222 was and who issued it.

b1-arpadhaz-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Counties and Castles
b1-arpadhaz-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how the kingdom was governed.
b1-arpadhaz-03.prompt: Tell the official who stood at the head of a county and what the county seat was.
cues: Say who stood at the head of the county
Say what the county seat was
b1-arpadhaz-03.target: Az ispán, aki a megye élén állt, a király nevében irányított. A megye székhelye a királyi vár volt.
b1-arpadhaz-03.english: The ispán, who stood at the head of the county, governed in the king's name. The county seat was the royal castle.
b1-arpadhaz-03.canDo: I can describe how the counties (vármegyék) and royal officials (ispánok) organized the kingdom.

b1-arpadhaz-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Church and Monasteries
b1-arpadhaz-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the Church in the Árpád period.
b1-arpadhaz-04.prompt: Tell the official where one of the earliest monasteries stood and what the monks did there.
cues: Name the place of the monastery
b1-arpadhaz-04.target: Pannonhalma, ahol bencés szerzetesek éltek, az egyik legkorábbi kolostor volt. A szerzetesek könyveket másoltak.
b1-arpadhaz-04.english: Pannonhalma, where Benedictine monks lived, was one of the earliest monasteries. The monks copied books.
b1-arpadhaz-04.canDo: I can describe how the Christian church was organized in the kingdom: dioceses, archbishops, bishops and monasteries.

b1-arpadhaz-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The End of the Line
b1-arpadhaz-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you how the Árpád dynasty ended.
b1-arpadhaz-05.prompt: Tell the official who the last Árpád king was, when he died and what the line was called that ended.
cues: Name the last king and the year he died
b1-arpadhaz-05.target: III. András, aki 1301-ben halt meg, volt az utolsó Árpád-házi király. Az Árpád-ház fiúága kihalt.
b1-arpadhaz-05.english: Andrew III, who died in 1301, was the last Árpád king. The male line of the Árpád dynasty died out.
b1-arpadhaz-05.canDo: I can explain what 'fiúág' means and why it mattered for royal succession.

b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Árpád Dynasty in Brief
b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to summarise the Árpád dynasty.
b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official in two sentences about the Golden Bull and the end of the dynasty.
cues: Say who issued the Golden Bull and when
Say when the dynasty died out
b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.target: II. András 1222-ben kiadta az Aranybullát. Az Árpád-ház fiúága 1301-ben kihalt.
b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.english: Andrew II issued the Golden Bull in 1222. The male line of the Árpád dynasty died out in 1301.
b1-arpadhaz-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate the story of the Árpád dynasty: notable kings, the Golden Bull, the kingdom's consolidation, church and state, and the end of the line in 1301.
